definition_zh: 指一个地区所有常住单位在一定时期内生产活动的最终成果（现价计算，单位：亿元人民币），是衡量地区经济总体规模的核心指标。
definition_en: Total final value of goods and services produced by all resident units in a province within a year, measured at current prices (100 million CNY).
headline_insight_zh: 2025年广东经济总量稳居第一，达 145,846.8 亿元
headline_insight_en: Guangdong leads provincial GDP at 145,846.8 100M CNY in 2025

source.agency_en: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS)

source.database_en: NBS National Data · Provincial & National Annual Databases

source.table_name_en: NBS National Data · Provincial GRP & National GDP (Current Prices)

caliber_note_zh: 本指标为当年现价名义值，同比百分比为名义增长率（含价格变动），区别于国家统计局按不变价核算的实际 GDP 增速。依据国民经济统一核算制度，全国 GDP 含部分难以分摊至省份的中央部门与跨区活动，因此31省之和与全国总计不强制相等。
caliber_note_en: Measured at current prices (nominal); YoY % reflects nominal growth rather than constant-price real growth. Under NBS unified accounting, national GDP includes unallocated central/cross-regional activities, so the 31-province sum does not equal national GDP identically.
transformation_zh: 直接使用国家统计局发布的现价亿元数值，保留1位小数；同比名义变化率按相邻年度现价数值计算。
transformation_en: Directly uses official NBS current-price figures (100M CNY) rounded to 1 decimal place.
revision_note_zh: 自2020年起实施地区生产总值统一核算改革；2024年底依据第五次全国经济普查（2023年为标准时点）对全国及各省历史 GDP 数据进行了全面修订，国家统计局数据库已同步反映修订后数值。
revision_note_en: Unified provincial GDP accounting launched in 2020; historical series were comprehensively revised following the 5th National Economic Census (2023 benchmark) and are reflected directly in NBS official records.
limitations_zh: 现价 GDP 受通胀与价格指数波动影响；最新一年初步核算数可能在次年最终核实或经济普查后小幅修订。
limitations_en: Current-price GDP reflects both volume growth and price level changes; the latest year's preliminary release is subject to final verification and economic census revisions.
nbs_annotation_zh: 按照我国国民经济核算数据修订制度和国际通行做法，在第五次全国经济普查后，对1992年-2023年地区生产总值历史数据进行了系统修订。

statistical_breaks.description_zh: 依据四经普结果修订历史数据，并于2020年初正式实施地区生产总值国家统一核算。
statistical_breaks.description_en: Historical series revised under the 4th Economic Census and unified national-provincial GDP accounting.

statistical_breaks.label_zh: 第五次全国经济普查修订
statistical_breaks.description_zh: 2024年底根据五经普结果对2023年及部分历史年份 GDP 进行了修订，纳入了城镇居民自有住房服务核算方法改进。
statistical_breaks.description_en: 5th National Economic Census revised 2023 and historical GDP, incorporating updated imputed-rent accounting.
